thursday.label: Legs (Quads / Hams / Glutes / Calves / Core)

thursday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle standing quad stretch 45s ea side + gentle hamstring stretch 45s ea side + calf stretch 45s ea side. No wide-stance or aggressive adductor stretching. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling OK tonight if the session was flag-free
